usedFor: Callbell is the customer inbox and HubSpot holds contacts, so “Contact Updated” can run “Update Contact” to keep them current.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Updated” in Callbell, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Changes made in the inbox reach HubSpot, so sales sees the same contact details as support.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the HubSpot contact by email, so “Contact Updated” must pass an email that already exists there.
